notes: All three Mount Hood areas share one Peakbagger record; every harvested track is a Timberline south-side ascent. No track assigned to any of the three routes. Tracks 3247306/3203959/3228175 have no route name and could fit the existing South Side (Hogsback) route (which already has a track). 2850250 has corrupt elevations (3 m) and is not usable. Newton Clark Headwall, Sunshine and West Crater Rim have no trailhead pins; no trailhead proposed because no track nominates Cloud Cap/Tilly Jane/Meadows. This area carries the shared missing list.

missing.name: Cooper Spur
alt_names: Cooper Spur from Mt. Hood Meadows
missing.overview: The classic northeast-side route. Hike from Cloud Cap or Tilly Jane to the stone shelter and moraine near 6,600 ft, then climb the Spur's crest and snow above the Eliot Glacier to the summit ridge. Rockfall and early-day timing matter as the snow softens.
evidence: https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105789896/mt-hood - lists Cooper Spur under North Side, Mod. Snow
web search: Mountaineers North Side page, season late May to early July; trailheads Cloud Cap 5,800 ft / Tilly Jane 5,760 ft (FR 3512)

missing.name: Leuthold Couloir
missing.overview: A steep snow couloir on the west face reached from Illumination Saddle, crossing the Reid Glacier where crevasse skills are needed. Ascended mostly in spring.
evidence: web search: SummitPost Leuthold Couloir page and Mountaineers Illumination Saddle page describe the Reid Glacier crossing

missing.name: Reid Glacier Headwall
missing.overview: Steep snow and ice on the west face above the Reid Glacier, from the Illumination Saddle staging area.
evidence: web search: Mountaineers Illumination Saddle routes

missing.name: Sandy Glacier Headwall
missing.overview: An intermediate ice and snow climb on the northwest side from Illumination Saddle, separate from the Reid headwall.
evidence: https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105789896/mt-hood - West Side, AI2 Mod. Snow PG13
web search: Mountaineers describe it as Grade III, AI1-2

missing.name: Yocum Ridge
missing.overview: The hardest of the west-side lines: a long ridge route between the Sandy and Reid sides. Rarely climbed.
evidence: https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105789896/mt-hood - West Side, AI3 Steep Snow R

missing.name: Old Chute
missing.overview: The most-logged variation of the south side: from the Hogsback, traverse to the crater rim and climb the chute left of Pearly Gates. Only add if the owner wants it separate from South Side (Hogsback); it shares the approach and may be a variation, not its own route.
evidence: peakbagger logged-route names in packets (Old Chute, South Side Old Chute)
https://www.mountainproject.com/route/107567616/west-crater-rim-route-wcr - describes the Old Chute as the final pitch

missing.name: Pearly Gates
missing.overview: The standard crater-rim chutes reached from the Hogsback; shares the approach with South Side (Hogsback), so it may be a variation rather than a separate route.
evidence: https://www.mountainproject.com/route/107567616/west-crater-rim-route-wcr - departs from the Pearly Gates/Hogsback line
